modules.title: Modules
modules.lead: The sections of the diaspora.ga members’ menu. The network serves the essentials from the start: the feed, members, countries, iCom and the account. Each module is opened or closed here, with a reason, and the decision is recorded in the log. Closing a module deletes no data: reopening it brings everything back.
modules.empty: This network has no module to open.

state.blocked: Closed: its required module is closed

card.adds: What it adds to the members’ menu
card.viaConsole: Decision taken from the platform console.
card.reasonInJournal: The reason can be read in the decision log.
card.neverDecided: No decision: closed since the network opened.
card.decidedButBlocked: Opening decided, with no effect while {{module}} stays closed.
card.blockedByChildren: Closes once the modules that live on it are closed: {{modules}}.

prerequisite.team: A moderation team is in place for each open country.

preview.title: Menu preview
preview.lead: The exact diaspora.ga members’ menu for the ticked modules, computed by the same rule as the members’ app. Nothing is saved: opening a module happens in “Modules”.
preview.modulesHint: At first, the modules open today. A module that lives on pages requires pages; pages are unticked once their modules are unticked.
